panels.title: Projected per year
panels.description: Average power of the last 7 days extrapolated to 365 days.

panels.title: Projected per month
panels.description: Average power of the last 7 days × 730 h.

panels.title: Energy per day
panels.description: Buckets are aligned to UTC midnight (01:00/02:00 local).

panels.title: Returned energy (if any)
panels.description: Energy flowing back through the plug (e.g. balcony solar). Usually 0.

panels.title: Power factor
panels.description: Only shown if the plug's firmware reports pf.

panels.title: Switches by source – range
panels.description: button, app/cloud, http, schedule, timer, init (power-up), WS_in (local), …

panels.title: Energy while ON per hour of on-time (avg load when on)
panels.description: Average power draw during the time the relay was on.

panels.title: Active device error flags
panels.description: Empty = good. Examples: overtemp, overpower, overvoltage.
